Saved report (e2e_out/factor_report.txt, E: package): '(a) SEL - U_a0: ... mean +0.37, 4/5 ... -> PASS', '(b) R_SEL - R_a0: ... mean +1.30, 5/5 ... -> PASS', 'best arm over the 5 folds: c5rl (mean g EER 25.32, a0 25.98)', 'GATE (a and b): PASS -> step 3 (final RFX = c5rl, Evaluation path)'.
